audit.description: Changed production files replace direct `requests` imports with `from requests_futures.sessions import FuturesSession` and instantiate `FuturesSession()` as `REQUESTS_SESSION`, then call `self._session.post(...)` in the LLM clients. Static and dynamic evidence show no source `requests` imports from production repo code; the only observed `requests` imports come from tests or from the real installed `requests_futures` dependency internals. The target origin resolves to site-packages `requests_futures`, and `target_local_spec_count` is 0, so there is no evidence of a local fake target provider.
evidence: Unified diff: `tinychat/llms/{anthropic,cohere,google,mistral,openai,together}.py` add `from requests_futures.sessions import FuturesSession` and replace `requests.post` with `self._session.post`.
Static anti-cheat: six production files have `imports_target: true`, `imports_source: false`, and `fake_target_added_code: false`.
Dynamic anti-cheat: `target_events_from_production_repo_count` is 9, including `FuturesSession` import/attribute access from `tinychat/llms/anthropic.py` and import from `tinychat/llms/cohere.py`.
Dynamic anti-cheat: `source_imports_from_production_repo_count` is 0 and `target_local_spec_count` is 0; `requests_futures` origin is under site-packages.
reasons: Direct `import requests` lines were removed from changed production files.
Dynamic evidence reports zero source imports from production repo code.
Target module origin is the installed dependency, with no local target provider detected.
